# Thunderbird Mail Interface Description

## System and Window Header

- **Operating System Indicator**: "Activities" is visible in the top-left corner, indicating a Linux desktop environment.
- **Application Title Bar**: "Thunderbird Mail" is displayed as the application name.
- **Current Date and Time**: "Oct 23 17:27" is shown in the center of the top bar.
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the top-right, including network, sound, and power icons.
- **Window Control Buttons**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons are present on the top-right corner.
- **Application Title**: "Inbox - anonym-x2024@outlook.com - Mozilla Thunderbird" is displayed in the title bar.

## Left Sidebar (Navigation Panel)

- **Application Dock Icons**: A vertical dock on the far left contains icons for various applications:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird Mail (currently active)
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help (Question Mark)
  - Trash
  - Settings (Gear Icon)
  - Application Grid (Nine Dots)

- **Email Account Section**:
  - **Account Name**: "anonym-x2024@outlook.com" is displayed with a folder icon.
  - **Folder Structure**:
    - Inbox (selected, highlighted in gray)
    - Drafts
    - Sent
    - Junk
    - Deleted (expanded, showing subfolders)
      - POP
      - Notes
      - Outbox
      - 封存 (Chinese for "Archived")
    - Local Folders (expanded, showing subfolders)
      - Trash
      - Outbox
      - Bills

## Main Content Area

### Message List Panel

- **Folder Header**: "Inbox 2 Messages" is displayed at the top.
- **Quick Filter Button**: "Quick Filter" with a funnel icon is located to the right of the folder header.
- **Message List**:
  - **Selected Message**:
    - **Sender**: "Outlook 小組" (Outlook Group)
    - **Subject**: "歡迎使用新的 Outlook.com 帳戶" (Welcome to your new Outlook.com account)
    - **Date**: "4/1/2024, 17:49"
    - **Status Icons**: Unread indicator (circle with "0") and star icon (not starred)
  - **Second Message**:
    - **Sender**: "Anonym Tester"
    - **Subject**: "A Test E-mail"
    - **Date**: "10/1/2024, 17:56"
    - **Status Icons**: Star icon (starred)

### Message Preview Panel

- **Message Header**:
  - **From**: "Outlook 小組" with email "no-reply@microsoft.com"
  - **To**: "Tester Anonym <anonym-x2024@outlook.com>"
  - **Date**: "4/1/2024, 17:49"
  - **Action Buttons**: Reply, Forward, Archive, Junk, Delete, More (dropdown), and Star icons.

- **Privacy Notice**:
  - Yellow banner: "To protect your privacy, Thunderbird has blocked remote content in this message."
  - "Preferences" dropdown and "X" (close) button on the right.

- **Message Body**:
  - **Microsoft Logo**: Top center.
  - **Main Text**:
    - "Anonym，您好" (Hello, Anonym)
    - "歡迎使用您的 Outlook! 我們的電子郵件服務是專為協助您戰勝每一天而設計。在您的所有裝置上免費連線、組織及完成工作。" (Welcome to your Outlook! Our email service is designed to help you conquer every day. Connect, organize, and complete work for free on all your devices.)
  - **QR Code Section**:
    - Title: "取得免費 Outlook 行動裝置應用程式" (Get the free Outlook mobile app)
    - Description: "iOS 版和 Android 版 Outlook 應用程式是免費的。他們讓使用各種帳戶和行事曆變得簡單而一致!" (iOS and Android versions of the Outlook app are free. They make using various accounts and calendars simple and consistent!)
    - Download buttons: "Download on the App Store" and "GET IT ON Google Play"
  - **Additional Features Section**:
    - "撰寫更好的電子郵件" (Write better emails)
    - Description: "使用 Microsoft 編輯器的進階人工智慧 (內建於 Outlook 的所有項目), 在您輸入時
